Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Medicine MBChB at University of St Andrews

What University of St Andrews asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of St Andrews courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 3 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (Medicine): High School Diploma with college-prep or honours science classes and a GPA of at least 3.5/4.0, plus at least three AP exams at 5 in one sitting, including Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics
  • St Andrews’ general SAT/ACT test-optional policy page refers Medicine applicants to the Medicine pages, which do not mention SAT or ACT

The Medicine US requirement is GPA plus three APs at 5; neither page says whether SAT/ACT scores are considered for Medicine.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: USA entry requirements · St Andrews: Medicine — International qualifications
English language
  • English language profile 2-M (Medicine): IELTS Academic 7.0 in all four components, at one sitting — irrespective of any other English qualification
  • IELTS has a two-year validity period; only the Academic IELTS is accepted
  • Four final years of secondary education in an English-medium school may be considered case by case
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: Medicine academic requirements · St Andrews: English language profile 2-M (Medicine)
Admissions tests
  • UCAT — required; applicants meeting the academic and other requirements are ranked by UCAT global score for interview

For 2026 entry the minimum UCAT scores selected for interview were 1500 (Home-funded and Scottish), 1640 (UK domicile) and 1710 (A100 overseas); St Andrews says it cannot predict 2027 cut-offs.

Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: Academic entry explained · St Andrews: Medicine — How students are selected · St Andrews: Medicine BSc (Hons) A100 2027 entry
Subject prerequisites
  • Required at A-Level: Chemistry plus one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics
  • Biology, Mathematics and English at GCSE/AS grade 5 or B if not taken at A-Level; at least five GCSEs at A or 7 at one sitting

Official: Chemistry plus one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics.

Official: standard entry AAA including Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics, all three A-Levels at one sitting; GCSE/AS grade 5 or B in Biology, Mathematics and English if not taken at A-Level, and at least five GCSEs at A or 7. The St Andrews programme is the BSc (Hons) Medicine (A100), followed by an MBChB at a partner medical school.

Other qualifications
  • Medicine: at least three AP exams at 5 in one sitting, including Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics, with a US High School Diploma (GPA 3.5+/4.0)
  • Biology, Mathematics and English must be taken in grade 11 or 12 if not offered as an AP
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: Medicine — International qualifications
Other requirements
  • Interview:
    • multiple mini-interviews
    • about 650 applicants are interviewed, selected by UCAT ranking among those with a strong academic record, a positive reference and relevant medically related work experience
  • Protecting Vulnerable Groups (PVG) scheme registration is required before arrival
  • Re-taken advanced-level qualifications are not normally considered; deferred entry is not considered

The selection page describes the 2026-entry interview arrangements (in person in St Andrews for Home-funded applicants, online for all other fee statuses); 2027-entry arrangements are not yet confirmed.
